timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Frace yourselves, folks. NASA has found three planets that are better than Earth.
The first is Kepler-22b. It is a super-Earth that is larger and more massive than the Earth.
This planet is probably completely covered in water, making it a gigantic ocean world.
Who knows what kind of alien creatures are swimming around there? The second second Earth is
Trappist-1e. There are seven rocky planets in the Trappist-1 system.
But Trappist-1e is the most promising candidate for life. Unfortunately, on one side there is
eternal day. On the other, it is always dark and cold. But right in the middle, there could be a
strip with perfect conditions for alien life. The third in the group is K-O-I-5-7-1-5, which the
researchers consider to be super-habitable. It is a billion years older than the Earth, so it has a
huge head start in terms of evolution. It is also heavier than the Earth, and with its more massive
atmosphere, can store more greenhouse gases, which can lead to more biomass.
